tiers.lead: Main session and orchestration; Product Manager, Spec Writer, Architect, Designer spec, preview and review, Copywriter, SEO, DevOps, design-time threat model, QA gate, repair-wave decisions. Does not author implementation or tests.
tiers.advisor: API contract; design-spec consult before the contract publishes; Security candidate review; fresh independent code review; Pentester findings; release verdict; advisor consults.
tiers.swarm: Read-only search and repo maps, file inventories, log and test-output triage, check runs.
tiers.worker: Authoring: implementation, tests and fixtures, refactors, mechanical document and copy edits, searches. Never plans, decides design, writes a contract, runs a gate, or reviews security.
